desc: Implement coordinate-compressed Fenwick trees for sliding-window frequencies, sums, median queries, and absolute-deviation costs.
Implement exact-`k` non-overlapping interval-selection DP with skip propagation and jumps of length `x`.
Validate both examples and edge cases, including the apparent Example 1 discrepancy.
Confirm `O(n log n + nk)` time, `O(n)` auxiliary memory, integer safety, imports, and required method signature.
